issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted answers. The n-gram vocabulary and IDF weights are built from train_smiles only. The test SMILES are only turned into features, and their labels are never used.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. SMILES character 2-4-grams are kept if they appear in at least 5 training molecules, weighted by sublinear TF times IDF, L2-normalised, then appended to the existing features. This is valid, though the extra dense columns may water down colsample_bytree=0.3.

The numbers support the rejection. The candidate scored 0.3772 against the incumbent's 0.3655, so it is 0.0117 worse. Recomputed z = -0.0117 / (0.0037*sqrt(1/1+1/2)) ≈ -2.58. The harness gives -2.567; the gap is probably rounding in the means. The reject decision is consistent with these numbers.
